summary: A dramatic open-air cocktail stop above the Chao Phraya, with a glowing circular bar and expansive skyline views. Shortlist it for a memorable dressed-up sunset drink; the view is the main attraction, and the premium bill needs checking before ordering.
whyGo: See Bangkok shift from daylight to illuminated river and city views from 247 metres up.
Recognise the famous Hangover Part II setting and try its associated Hangovertini.
bestFor: Couples, skyline photographers and travellers seeking one celebratory evening drink.
skipIf: You dislike heights, premium hotel-bar prices or dress requirements.
You need guaranteed seating, a meal at the bar or access for children under seven.
duration: Allow 60–90 minutes plus possible entry queues; suggested planning allowance, not an official time limit.
cost: Official FAQ specifies at least one drink per person. Current cocktail prices were not verified. An older official menu lists spirits from THB 790, plus 10% service and 7% tax; treat this solely as historical context and inspect the current menu first.
hours: Official FAQ: daily 17:00–00:30; last drinks 00:15. Reconfirm for holiday dates.
bestTime: Arrive near opening for daylight, sunset and the first city lights in one visit; visibility and weather determine the payoff.
gettingThere: State Tower, 1055 Silom Road, Bang Rak; ask hotel staff for the Sky Bar lift. Use BTS Saphan Taksin for the neighbourhood, then confirm the walking route on a map, or take a taxi to State Tower.
booking: Walk-in only under normal operating rules; no bar reservation required. Restaurant bookings are separate.
accessibility: Lift access to the building does not establish step-free access to the outdoor bar. Rooftop steps, accessible toilets and seating arrangements were not verified; ask the venue before travelling if these matter.
practicalTips: Wear smart casual clothes; avoid athletic wear, flip-flops and male sleeveless tops.
Leave backpacks and shopping bags at your hotel: the venue says it has no luggage storage.
Eat elsewhere first; the FAQ describes drinks-only service.
Photos are allowed, but no tripods, external flash or video recording per venue policies.
decemberNotes: Plan a flexible early-evening visit and check the forecast on the day. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve may involve special arrangements; ordinary walk-in rules and normal pricing should not be assumed for these dates. December 2026 bar-specific event terms were not verified.
uncertainties: Current drink prices, seating availability and queue duration remain unknown.
Official FAQ mentions a snack last-order time while also stating no food service: plan on drinks only.
Step-free rooftop access and special holiday admission conditions need confirmation.
